ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.

   D. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   B. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   B. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

11. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   B. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Hajj and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Ibadah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Adalah, Justice 02 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam, Intoxicants 03 5.4 Israf,extravaga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

2. C — Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. B — Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. D — Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. C — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

12. B — Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hajj; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Virtues; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
